title: Spikers' Turf: AEP-Cabstars survives Abdilla's onslaught for breakthrough win
summary: AEP-Cabstars survived a 37-point onslaught from Ranran Abdilla to take down the Armed Forces of the Philippines and grab their first win in the Spikers' Turf Invitational Conference on Sunday.
